profile.statement: Figuring out how things should work — and whether designing them is what I want to do.
questions: Is design — working out what something should be — what I actually want to do?
Which parts of making something should I not hand to AI?
What changes when I make something for a real person, not just for myself?
profile.about:
I'm studying Information Systems at SMU. The degree isn't about design, so this site is where I explore it in my own time.

In poly, UX design and front-end web development came easily to me — far more easily than maths. I like working out what something should be, solving the problem, and ending up with something you can actually use. I've also noticed I don't enjoy code for its own sake.

So this is a direction I'm choosing to explore seriously, not a title I've earned. The site is the record: what I make, what I try, and how my thinking changes. Every few months I write a checkpoint asking whether it's still the direction.

I'm exploring AI the same way — until I can confidently say I use it as a tool.
